ticket.summary: Manager decisions update the leave balance
ticket.description:
Remaining leave should reflect what a manager has decided.
Acceptance criteria
- An employee sees their remaining leave days on the "My time off" screen.
- Submitting a request does not change the remaining days while the request is pending.
- When a manager approves a request, the requested number of days is deducted from the employee's remaining days.
- When a manager rejects a request, the employee's remaining days do not change.
- The number of days in a request is the count of calendar days from the first day to the last day, inclusive.

pullRequest.title: HR-201 Manager decisions update the leave balance
pullRequest.body: Approving a request deducts its days from the employee's remaining leave; rejecting leaves it unchanged.

docs.text:
# Dayoff (demonstration app B)

A time-off request tool. Employees request leave; managers decide requests.

## Behaviour

- Every employee has a number of leave days remaining.
- A request has a first day, a last day and a reason, and starts as Pending.
- A manager approves or rejects each pending request. A decided request cannot
  be decided again.

## API

All endpoints take and return JSON and use the session cookie.

| Method and path | Who | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/session` | anyone | Sign in with `{handle, password}` |
| `DELETE /api/session` | signed in | Sign out |
| `GET /api/me` | signed in | The current user, including `balance` for employees |
| `GET /api/requests` | signed in | Own requests (employee) or all requests (manager) |
| `POST /api/requests` | employee | Create a request from `{start, end, reason}`; dates are `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `POST /api/requests/:id/decision` | manager | `{decision: "approve" \| "reject"}` |

## Running

`TEST_MODE=1 GIT_SHA=<commit> PORT=3100 node server.mjs`.
